points.S1: 授权人员换，先隔离能量

shots.scene: 欣欣站在打开侧板的焊机旁，手里拿着防静电腕带
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a handheld laser welder with its side panel removed, holding an antistatic wrist strap, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第三十四课：焊机部件更换（一）。
overlay: 焊机部件更换（一）：通用流程与电源部件

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着螺丝刀要打开机壳
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a screwdriver and reaches toward the side panel of a welder that is still plugged in, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：电源坏了？我拆开看看！

shots.scene: 老李拦住，指着电源插头和高压标志
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops him and points at the power plug and a high voltage warning sign on the welder.
shots.narration: 老李：里面有高压，学生不能开壳。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a blank flow chart with icons for power off, wait, photo, replace, check and test.
shots.narration: 老李：更换要按通用流程来。

shots.section_title: 授权人员换，先隔离能量
shots.scene: 设备管理员或厂家售后
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welder with an open cabinet and badges for an equipment manager and an authorised service engineer, a student icon outside the line. No text.
shots.narration: 内部更换只由授权维修人员做。
overlay: 授权人员换，先隔离能量

shots.section_title: 授权人员换，先隔离能量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the plug pulled out and a lockout padlock with a tag fitted on the supply. No text.
shots.narration: 断电拔插头，上锁挂牌。

shots.section_title: 授权人员换，先隔离能量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the gas cylinder valve closed and the regulator gauge falling to zero. No text.
shots.narration: 关闭气瓶阀，泄掉管路压力。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tool tray with large and small cross head screwdrivers, a flat screwdriver, hex keys, an open wrench, tweezers and cable ties. No text.
shots.narration: 按要换的部件，备好工具。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new spare part box compared with the old part by a matching nameplate icon, a different looking part crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 备件用规格一致的原厂配件。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of tools laid out in a tray beside a parts box on a workbench lit by a lamp, next to an unplugged welder.
shots.narration: 工具放托盘，工位照明要亮。

shots.scene: 电源线、焊枪线全部断开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: power cord, torch cable, wire feeder cable and work clamp cable all disconnected from the welder. No text.
shots.narration: 电源线、焊枪线等全部断开。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the shielding gas supply valve closed and the gas hose disconnected. No text.
shots.narration: 接着的保护气也先关好。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: all four caster brakes of the welder pressed down, a sliding machine crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住，机器不滑动。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unplugged welder with a clock, capacitors inside with a discharge arrow and heat fading. No text.
shots.narration: 静置一段时间，让机器放电冷却。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a manual icon with a clock symbol and a checkmark. No text.
shots.narration: 等多久，以说明书规定为准。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer with an electrician badge checks terminals with a voltage tester, a zero icon on the tester.
shots.narration: 开盖后，由电工验电确认无电。

shots.scene: 【实拍】戴防静电腕带，夹到接地点
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a technician fastening an antistatic wrist strap and clipping its lead to the earthing point of an unplugged welder chassis.
shots.narration: 戴好防静电腕带，夹到接地点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a circuit board held by its edges, fingers touching the chips crossed out, an antistatic bag. No text.
shots.narration: 电路板拿边缘，放进防静电袋。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the side door panel of the welder opened, the internal mounting plate visible. No text.
shots.narration: 打开侧面门板或盖板。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: screws removed and dropped into a labelled compartment parts box, a screw falling into the machine crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下的螺钉放进零件盒，别丢进机内。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand holding a rear handle while the last screw is removed, a falling handle hitting a foot crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 拆最后一颗时扶住，免得砸下。

shots.scene: 先拆接地线，放平安装板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the earth wire unscrewed from the mounting plate, then the plate laid down flat exposing the electrical area. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下接地线，放平安装板。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a phone camera photographing the wiring on a terminal block of an unplugged welder.
shots.narration: 拆线之前，先拍照留底。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small numbered tag icons attached to each wire near its terminal. No text.
shots.narration: 每根线贴上标签，装回不会接错。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: side cutters snipping a cable tie with the blade away from the cable insulation. No text.
shots.narration: 剪扎带时刀口朝外，别剪到线。

shots.scene: 压弹片拔线，一根一根拆
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flat screwdriver pressing a terminal spring while one wire is pulled out, wires removed one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 压住弹片再拔，线一根一根拆。

shots.scene: 托住部件再拆最后一颗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand supporting a power supply module while the last screw is removed, a module falling onto parts below crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 拆最后一颗螺丝，用手托住部件。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a module unclipped from a silver mounting rail with a flat screwdriver and slid off. No text.
shots.narration: 撬开卡扣，从导轨上滑出来。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a whole component plate lifted out and placed on a workbench for further work. No text.
shots.narration: 组件太紧凑，整块取到台面再拆。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrench holding a nut while a hex key turns the screw, the force direction away from the other hand. No text.
shots.narration: 扳手卡稳再用力，方向别对着手。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new module placed in the original position with a direction arrow, a bracket hook facing outward. No text.
shots.narration: 新件放回原位，方向别装反。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the new module clipped onto the rail and its fixing screws tightened. No text.
shots.narration: 卡进导轨，固定螺钉拧紧。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a part pressed into its mounting hole with a click sound icon. No text.
shots.narration: 按入安装孔，咔嗒一声才算牢。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wiring reference picture beside the terminals, each wire connected while matching the picture. No text.
shots.narration: 对照参考图，一根一根接回。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wire colours matched to terminal positions with checkmarks, a swapped pair crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 位置、颜色都要和参考图一致。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrong connection producing smoke and a burnt board icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 接反接错，通电就可能烧坏。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the photo from before compared with the finished wiring, a second checkmark. No text.
shots.narration: 接完对照照片，再核对一遍。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a terminal screw tightened on bare copper, stray strands and clamped insulation crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 端子拧紧，铜丝不外露、不分叉。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers gently tugging each wire on a terminal block of an unplugged welder to check it is secure.
shots.narration: 每根线轻轻一拉，确认不松。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an insulated screwdriver on one terminal, a tool bridging two terminals with a spark crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用绝缘柄工具，一次只动一根线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: loose wire ends wrapped with insulating caps and kept apart. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下的线头包好绝缘，彼此分开。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a cable tie fastened around a wire bundle inside an unplugged welder, leaving it snug but not cutting the insulation.
shots.narration: 扎带固定线缆，太紧会勒伤线皮。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wires passing through a black ferrite ring with the same number of turns as before. No text.
shots.narration: 穿磁环的线照原样，不能省。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cables routed along the original path with a grommet at a hole, cables on a sharp edge and a hot part crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 走原来的路，避开锐边和热源。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dust in the cabinet cleaned with a soft brush and a vacuum, compressed air blowing crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 机柜积灰，刷一刷吸一吸，不直吹。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clear protective cover refitted over the power terminals, a finger touching terminals blocked. No text.
shots.narration: 端子前的透明防护罩一定装回。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the earth wire screwed back onto the panel with a protective earth symbol and a checkmark. No text.
shots.narration: 接地线一定装回，螺钉全拧上。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: motor cable reconnected, panels hooked onto pins, handles refitted, no spare screws left in the parts box. No text.
shots.narration: 接回电机线，装回面板和把手。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tools in the tray counted against outlines, a screwdriver left inside the machine crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 合盖前清点工具，不落在机内。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the torch fixed in its holder aimed at a metal shield, the operator wearing laser safety glasses, others standing back. No text.
shots.narration: 首次通电，枪口朝挡板，旁人退开。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: indicator lights and a blank screen checked first, then a short test with a checkmark. No text.
shots.narration: 先看指示和报警，再按规程试焊。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: smoke or an alarm icon and a hand pressing the emergency stop button. No text.
shots.narration: 有异常立即急停，查明再试。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of the welder cabinet with the electrical area highlighted behind the mounting plate. No text.
shots.narration: 电源类部件，集中在机内电气区。

shots.scene: 开关电源：低压直流给主控
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a switched mode power supply module on a rail turning alternating current into low voltage direct current for the main control board. No text.
shots.narration: 开关电源把交流变低压直流供主板。

shots.scene: 交流电源板：分配交流电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alternating current power board distributing incoming power to several modules. No text.
shots.narration: 交流电源板，把交流电分给各部件。

shots.scene: 激光电源：给激光器供电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large laser power supply module feeding the laser source, a high voltage warning sign on it. No text.
shots.narration: 激光电源给激光器供电，功率大。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the laser power supply with its bracket and a plug connector, lifted out as one assembly. No text.
shots.narration: 带支架整体装取，接头要插牢。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: capacitors inside the laser power supply holding charge after unplugging, a clock and a voltage tester. No text.
shots.narration: 断电后电容可能仍带电，等放电。

shots.scene: 直流电源：给直流部件供电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a direct current power supply module feeding direct current loads inside the welder. No text.
shots.narration: 直流电源给机内直流部件供电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clear cover in front of the output terminals of the direct current power supply. No text.
shots.narration: 端子前的透明罩，防手和工具碰电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the new power supply nameplate compared with the old for output voltage and power, a similar looking unit crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 输出电压功率要一致，不能凑合。

shots.scene: 接触器：控制主电路通断
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alternating current contactor on a rail switching the main circuit on and off by a small control signal. No text.
shots.narration: 交流接触器控制主电路通断。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: welded contacts inside a contactor keeping the main circuit on after switching off, a plug pulled out icon. No text.
shots.narration: 触点粘住关不掉，就拔插头拉闸。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a contactor with a buzzing sound icon, chattering arrows and heat waves, a stop and power off icon. No text.
shots.narration: 持续嗡嗡响、发烫，停机报修。

shots.scene: 【实拍】认读开关上的 I 和 O
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a rocker power switch on the welder panel showing the line symbol for on and the circle symbol for off.
shots.narration: 竖线是通，圆圈是断。

shots.scene: 按到圆圈侧，灯灭才算关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the rocker switch pressed to the circle side and its indicator light going out. No text.
shots.narration: 按到圆圈一侧，灯灭才算关了。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new rocker switch inserted from outside with the circle side down, wires matched by colour. No text.
shots.narration: 装时圆圈统一朝下，线色对端子。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the old power module bagged and labelled, handed to the equipment manager for asset and electronic waste handling. No text.
shots.narration: 旧件交设备管理员，按规定处置。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a repair log with date, part icon, photo icon, test result and signatures. No text.
shots.narration: 更换内容和试机结果写进记录。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an authorised badge, a plug out, a discharge clock and a wrist strap. No text.
shots.narration: 授权人员换，断电放电防静电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a camera, a reference picture, a tug check and an earth symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 拍照留底，对图接线，接地装回。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons for switched mode supply, power board, laser supply, direct current supply, contactor and rocker switch. No text.
shots.narration: 认清六类电源部件的位置和作用。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着主控板和气动组件
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a control board and a small pneumatic valve assembly, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：焊机部件更换（二）：控制与气路部件。
